topography.project_purpose: Structural profile: 92 project-authored contract(s) across 3 chain(s); 1 ERC20 token, 45 Chainlink feeds; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 3 functional families. Its contracts share 7 common project-authored base contract(s) (redstoneconsumernumericbase, redstoneconsumerbase, calldataextractor). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
